proposals.title: Add multi-network governance weight snapshot
proposals.description: Snapshot the 3-factor vote weight (recursive 30% / children 40% / staked 30%) per block so historical dashboards can render past governance states.

proposals.title: Emoji gift revenue split audit
proposals.description: Publish a monthly report of the perpetual proportional revenue split among gift owners (no burn, no expiry — dilution by design).

proposals.title: Mirror EVOLVE token metadata to Codeberg Pages
proposals.description: Serve the static tokenomics docs from Codeberg Pages so every forge mirror stays self-contained (ban-resistance).

proposals.title: Gitea webhook receiver spec
proposals.description: Define the webhook payload contract for issue events, kept compatible with the shared GitHub/Gitea issue shape.

proposals.title: Zero-downtime proposals manifest deploy
proposals.description: Serve proposals.json from IPFS gateways with fallback to the pinned copy committed in the repo — no central server in the loop.

proposals.title: GitLab CI mirror pipeline
proposals.description: Cross-compile the proposals manifest between forges so each mirror can regenerate it independently.
